nom: La Roche-Posay Retinol B3 Face Serum for Fine Lines & Wrinkles

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum does not make skin feel greasy and one says it kept oily skin clear overnight, though one reviewer says it made her skin very oily during the day and she had to stop using it.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the serum as non-drying and gentle, though a few mention temporary dryness for a few days after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it is not drying, helps keep congested areas clear, and does not cause breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers frequently report no irritation and good tolerance, but several single out the added fragrance and denatured alcohol as problematic, and one with sensitive rosacea skin says it was sticky and broke her out.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report smoother, brighter skin and reduced fine lines/sun damage, describing it as gentle enough for long-term or first-time retinol use at an older age.
segments.normal: One reviewer with good, non-sensitive skin in her 40s reports visible fading of age spots within days.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using the product for fine lines, wrinkles, smile lines, or sun damage report visible smoothing, firmness, or reduction of lines and age spots within weeks; one reviewer of 4 months saw no change in lines or texture and one 82-year-old reviewer says it has helped somewhat but not dramatically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it is not drying and keeps skin moisturized when paired with a moisturizer, but a few report the skin feels dry or tight for the first days of use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers largely report no redness or irritation, including one who says she never saw redness despite occasional irritation; one reviewer with rosacea reports breakouts but not explicit redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle and non-irritating even for beginners and sensitive skin, with thermal water cited as soothing; one reviewer noted her skin needed a slow, gradual introduction to avoid intolerance.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report lightening or fading of sun spots, age spots, and dark spots within days to weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne report acne scars and breakouts clearing up and pores minimizing over weeks to months; however, others report new painful acne or morning breakouts starting soon after use, one attributing it to the fragrance.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with a 40-year history of oily skin says it kept her face clear and non-oily overnight, while another reviewer reports the product made her skin very oily during the day.

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this because I do love some of their other products but this just did not work for my skin. I'm a natural redhead with sensitive, rosacea skin and this is just too sticky and it broke me out.

extraits.titre: Good for Mature, Dry Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I tried this because I love La-Roche Posay products. I have used it over a month without any allergic reactions and it has lessened some of my wrinkles. However, the scent/perfume in the product is overwhelming and was, at first, very off-putting. I don't like any fragrance in my face products unless it's subtle so if you're highly sensitive to fragrance this is not the product for you. I was able to get used to the scent over time but I wish they would not have put it in this product.

I am a first-time user of Retinol B3 Pure Retinol Serum. It is not drying on my sensitive, combination skin, and I like the smell of it too. I have not used it enough to see any difference in my skin, but I am hopeful and will make a decision to repurchase or not when the bottle is empty.

extraits.titre: It helped with my pores and sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I am in my late 20's. I have a combination skin of oily and dry. I have problems with large pores now, and it's just not cute. I have used this product for the past 8 months, and I love it. I use it for my nightly skin care routine. It helps minimize my pore. The product doesn't irritate my skin at all. Be careful when using and don't mix it with a chemical exfoliant -or- benzoyl peroxide. This will irritate your skin. If you exfoliate one night, then skip using this retinol.

This is the product I was looking for and finally found. I honestly wish I knew it existed sooner, as it would have spared me from all my skin concerns. I recently bought it a week ago and already see positive results on my skin. I have dry, sensitive skin and it immediately exfoliated away the dullness on my skin. In addition, it is stopping my skin from breaking out. The product also didn't irritate my skin. As far as anti-aging goes, it already seems to have smoothed over areas of my skin with fine lines and is healing acne scars. It's well worth the money. I've already recommended the product to others after they noticed an improvement in my skin and wanted to know what I used to get the results. You won't regret buying this product if it gives you the same results as it did for me.

I have bought this retinol at least 4 times at this point and absolutely love it! I have super sensitive skin and it does not irritate me at all (which is so rare). I have used prescribed retinols in the past, but they always leave my skin red and dry. Generally, I don't use it everyday, usually every other. I think it has improved my skin texture and evened my skin tone. Definitely worth the money and usually lasts me at least a month!

This is my first time trying a retinol serum and I am very happy. I have fought oily skin for 40 years. This product kept my face clear all night and looked great in the morning. Definitely part of my skin routine now.
